blocks.html:
Full Vinyl Wrap on Mednow’s Smart Car with Avery Dennison Colors

Mednow is a Toronto-based company that delivers prescriptions to customers’ doors.

They are always looking for ways to increase their brand visibility, and when they heard about our services, they came to us with an idea: they wanted to have a full vinyl wrap with their logo and website put on the side of a Smart Car. They said they thought it would be a cool way to drive around town and advertise their business.

We were more than happy to oblige! We got started immediately on their full vinyl wrap, and it didn’t take long before we had the whole thing wrapped up. We even helped them pick out some colours and design ideas—we knew exactly what would look good on this car.

When Mednow saw their new ride in action, they couldn’t stop talking about it! They said people from all over were stopping them on the street asking about how they could get one too. It really increased their brand visibility in a big way! And now Mednow has another great tool, a full vinyl wrap, for driving attention towards their brand—and who knows how many other businesses will want to take advantage of this opportunity once word gets out? So if you’re looking for a way to get your business noticed with a full vinyl wrap, we can help! We’ve got plenty of ideas for custom paint jobs that will attract attention wherever you drive.

And don’t forget—if you want multiple colours or even a design on the side of your car, we can do that too! So what are you waiting for? Contact us today to get started on your new custom vehicle wrap! There’s no better way to get your business noticed than by wrapping a custom car wrap around it! And if you’re looking for a simple and effective way to drive attention toward your brand, we can help. We’ll work with you to design and install a vehicle wrap that will attract attention wherever you go—and hopefully plenty of new customers too!

If you would like to personalize your car, truck, boat, or other personal items – as long as it fits into our garage and has a smooth surface, we would love to wrap it! For your inspiration or your next partial wrap with Vinyl Wrap Toronto, do not forget to check out our Portfolio.

Get a Free Quote today by filling out the form and our team will get back to you as soon as possible. You can reach us at 416-746-1381 or email us at info@vinylwraptoronto.com. You can also visit us at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4.

Don’t forget to follow us on Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, and Pinterest to hear about our special deals, creative wrap projects, and vehicle branding.
